capabilities: render Daily Note tasks as a vertical timeline with a current-time indicator
show scheduled vs. completed time per category as bar charts
add tasks via modal and navigate between days
autocomplete category tags and durations while typing
warn when daily work hours exceed a configurable limit
extras: Requires Daily Notes with a '## Timeline' section; durations are needed for accurate stats, otherwise gaps between tasks are used.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize Daily Note tasks as a timed schedule with category-based time tracking.
summary: Task timeline plugin that renders Daily Note tasks as a vertical time-block schedule with per-category completion stats.
